description: This Java class 'LoanSummary' encapsulates all the summary details of a Loan object, including various financial totals such as principal, interest, fees, penalties, and outstanding amounts. It provides methods to update, reset, and calculate these totals based on repayment installments and charges.

classes.name: LoanSummary
classes.description: Represents a comprehensive summary of a loan's financial state, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and outstanding amounts, with methods to update and calculate these totals based on repayment data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate LoanSummary with a specified fee charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: zeroFields
methods.description: Resets all financial total fields to zero, except for totalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Updates all summary totals based on repayment installments, charges, principal, and capitalized income/adjustments.

methods.name: updateTotalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Sets the total fee charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: getTotalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Returns the total fee charges due at disbursement as a Money object.

methods.name: getTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the total outstanding amount as a Money object.

methods.name: updateFeeChargeOutstanding
methods.description: Updates the total fee charges outstanding.

methods.name: updatePenaltyChargeOutstanding
methods.description: Updates the total penalty charges outstanding.

methods.name: updateFeeChargesWaived
methods.description: Updates the total fee charges waived.

methods.name: updatePenaltyChargesWaived
methods.description: Updates the total penalty charges waived.

methods.name: isRepaidInFull
methods.description: Checks if the loan is fully repaid based on outstanding amounts.

methods.name: calculateTotalPrincipalRepaid
methods.description: Calculates total principal repaid from repayment installments.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeeChargesWrittenOff
methods.description: Calculates total fee charges written off.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyChargesWrittenOff
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charges written off.

methods.name: calculateTotalChargesRepaidAtDisbursement
methods.description: Calculates total charges paid at disbursement.
